evaluation_components.when: To be announced in the class.

evaluation_components.component: Class discussions and Assignments linked to attendance

attendance_policy: Each student is expected to attend the classes and write all the components. Also, it is mandatory for the students to submit the assignments.
makeup_policy: Make up will be given strictly to genuine cases only i.e. (i) Sickness leading to hospitalization, (ii) out of station with prior intimation & permission. It will be given for the mid-semester and comprehensive examination only.
